before.exam_tip_html: When analysing the Diane Nash and CJ Reminder scenes, always identify the contrast between characters. Examiners reward answers that compare two performers’ techniques side by side. For example: “Diane Nash remained stoic with strong posture, whereas the US representative used quick, exaggerated movements. This contrast highlighted Nash’s unshakeable conviction versus the representative’s growing desperation.” Showing you can identify contrasts demonstrates sophisticated understanding of performance skills.
